span.p:
One bounded action per request: cpu.weight, memory.high, or supported io.weight / io.max.
Each resource has an independent capability and safety gate. memory.max and process termination are excluded.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Block new AI writes. Restore a captured value only for a verified AIOS-owned target.
If safe rollback fails, stay fail-closed and report degraded mode.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Default mode. Viewers can read status only.
The dashboard cannot change mode or authorize actions.
